en.headline: Public hospital fee reform lifts full-waiver beneficiaries more than 20-fold
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said government subsidy remains at 95 per cent after the January changes, with a five-year target of 90 per cent, while 17 new drugs have been added to the formulary.
body: The number of people receiving full medical fee waivers at public hospitals has risen from about 14,000 to 280,000 since the fees and charges reform took effect in January, Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said on Saturday.

Speaking on a radio programme, Lo said the previous overall government subsidy rate of 97.6 per cent had been adjusted under the principle of co-payment by those who can afford it. The current subsidy stands at 95 per cent, with a target of 90 per cent within five years. An annual fee cap of HK$10,000 without means testing continues to apply.

Seventeen drugs, including some specialist medicines, have been added to the Hospital Authority drug formulary under the new arrangements. One blood-cancer targeted therapy that previously cost patients HK$20,000 to HK$40,000 every four weeks is now available for a standard charge of HK$20 per four-week cycle for eligible patients.
Lo also commented on proposed changes to the Medical Council disciplinary framework and the need for stronger professional ethics training after recent cases involving hospital doctors.

zh.headline: 公院收費改革後全額豁免人數增逾20倍 政府仍資助95%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，改革後政府資助維持95%，五年目標降至90%，藥物名冊已新增17種藥包括專科用藥。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂周六在電台節目表示，公營醫院收費改革自1月實施以來，獲全額醫療費用豁免的人數由約1.4萬人增至28萬人，增幅逾20倍。
他指以往政府對公營醫療的資助達97.6%，改革以能者共付為原則，目前資助仍達95%，目標於五年內降至90%。改革後設有毋須經濟審查的每年1萬元全年收費上限。
改革實施至今，已將17種藥物納入藥物名冊，部分屬專科用藥。一款血癌標靶藥以往患者每四星期需自費約2萬至4萬元，現時合資格病人每四星期只需付20元。
盧寵茂亦談及醫務委員會處分機制改革建議，以及近期醫院醫生違規個案後需加強專業道德培訓。
